'''Emarin Pandaloan''' was a noble of [[House Pendaloan]] of [[Tear]]. He was the younger brother to [[Algarin|Lord Algarin]]. 

== Activities ==
Emarin was able to [[channel]] but was found by [[Cadsuane]] and was taken to the [[White Tower]] to be [[gentle]]d. Cadsuane helped him survive for ten years after being gentled.
